---
title: "Corredores endemicos"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

```{r setup, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# 1. Datos
datos <- read_excel("ParaCorredores.xlsx", sheet = "corredoresCasoSE") %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  select(anio, corredor, semana, casos, poblacion)

anio_actual   <- max(datos$anio)
semana_actual <- max(datos$semana[datos$anio == anio_actual])

datos <- datos %>%
  group_by(corredor) %>%
  complete(anio, semana = 1:53, fill = list(casos = 0)) %>%   # para completar semanas faltantes = 0
  arrange(anio, semana) %>%
  fill(poblacion, .direction = "downup") %>%                  
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!(anio == anio_actual & semana > semana_actual)) %>% 
  group_by(corredor, anio) %>%
  mutate(inc     = casos / poblacion * 1e5,
         inc_acu = cumsum(casos) / poblacion * 1e5) %>%
  ungroup()

unique(datos$corredor)                      

```

```{r}
# 2. Función del corredor
graficar <- function(df, var, titulo) {

  corredor <- df %>%
    filter(anio < anio_actual) %>%
    group_by(semana) %>%
    summarise(q1 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
              q2 = median(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
              q3 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")

  actual <- filter(df, anio == anio_actual)
  tope   <- max(corredor$q3, actual[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

  ggplot(corredor, aes(semana)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0,  ymax = q1,   fill = "Éxito"),
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, outline.type = "upper") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q2,   fill = "Seguridad"),
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q2, ymax = q3,   fill = "Alerta"),
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q3, ymax = tope, fill = "Brote"),
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, outline.type = "lower") +
    geom_line(data = actual, aes(y = .data[[var]], color = factor(anio_actual)),
              linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL,
      values = c(Éxito = "#BEDDE6", Seguridad = "#A0CD63",
                 Alerta = "#FFFD54", Brote = "#EA3223"),
      breaks = c("Brote", "Alerta", "Seguridad", "Éxito")) +
    scale_color_manual(NULL, values = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 52, by = 4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = titulo, x = "Semana epidemiológica",
         y = "Casos por 100.000 hab.") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
# 3. Gráficos
graficar(filter(datos, corredor == "INFLUENZA"),    "inc",     "Influenza: incidencia semanal")
graficar(filter(datos, corredor == "VARICELA"), "inc", "Varicela: incidencia semanal")
graficar(filter(datos, corredor == "VARICELA"), "inc_acu", "Varicela: incidencia acumulada")
graficar(filter(datos, corredor == "TUBERCULOSIS"),    "inc_acu",     "Tuberculosis: incidencia acumulada")

```
